description:
Apply Terraform changes to real infrastructure.

TWO-STEP SAFETY FLOW:
1. Call without confirmed=true → runs terraform plan, shows the diff, returns without applying.
2. Call with confirmed=true after reviewing the diff → actually applies the changes.

Never pass confirmed=true without first showing the plan output to the user.

confirmed.description: Must be true to actually apply. Omit or set false to preview only.

planFile.description: Path to a saved plan file from tf_plan (recommended for exact apply)

target.description: Limit operation to a specific resource address, e.g. aws_instance.web

vars.description: Variable overrides in key=value format, e.g. ["region=us-east-1"]

workdir.description: Absolute or relative path to the directory containing .tf files

workspace.description: Terraform workspace to use (default: current workspace)

name: tf_apply
